Use **`VectorStoreIndex`**, from `llama_index.core`. It chunks documents, embeds them, and stores the vectors. Load your files first with **`SimpleDirectoryReader`**:

```python
from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader

documents = SimpleDirectoryReader("path/to/your/docs").load_data()
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)

query_engine = index.as_query_engine()
print(query_engine.query("Your question here"))
```

By default this uses an in-memory store and OpenAI embeddings, so you'll need an `OPENAI_API_KEY` set or another embedding model configured. To save the index to disk and reload it later:

```python
index.storage_context.persist(persist_dir="./storage")

from llama_index.core import StorageContext, load_index_from_storage
storage_context = StorageContext.from_defaults(persist_dir="./storage")
index = load_index_from_storage(storage_context)
```

I don't know which LlamaIndex version or project setup you're using, so these import paths assume the current `llama_index.core` package layout. If you're on an older version, the imports may differ.
